dogecoin.text:
Over a year ago I bought dogecoin as a fucking joke. I spent $7 for 2,291 $doge. That's worth roughly $1,200 today. Crypto is fucking wild. 

*For the record I no longer hold any dogecoin 🤣 https://t.co/pvcjQzYN5i

What people are seeing with $AMC is the norm in the world of #crypto. $AMC is up over 1,000% this year. Meme coins like $DOGE are up over 14,000%. $MATIC is up 8,000%. Fuck stocks, crypto is on another level. If you know, you know...
Notice how now that crypto is down no one has been saying anything. But when dogecoin was 70¢ everyone and their mommas were trying to buy in.
